title: Eldra's book
goals: Keep the book under a name with find_nearest.
starting_code: # A locked door, a high shelf, and Eldra waiting at the end.
hints: One thing at a time: the key, the door, the shelf, then Eldra.
Keep the book under a name before the spell moves it: `find_nearest` finds it on the shelf.
fendra brings the book onto the wizard's tile; pick it up before you walk on.
intro: I remember now: I left my book on the shelf behind the locked door, the night I became a ghost. Will you fetch it for me?
outro: You found it, {wizard}, just where I left it. Now I can rest. The passages wait for you next: mind Dask.
